title: narcissus sylvestris proles johnstonii
intro: Narcissus sylvestris proles johnstonii, commonly known as Johnston's narcissus, is a wildflower species belonging to the Amaryllidaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antifungal properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of colds, flu, and respiratory infections. The therapeutic actions of Johnston's narcissus include its ability to stimulate the immune system and exhibit antioxidant activity, contributing to its potential as a natural remedy. Bioactive constituents present in this plant include alkaloids, such as galantamine and lycorine, which have been studied for their potential neuroprotective and anti-inflammatory effects.
